svg.title: The four while loops of the Manhattan planner
svg.desc: Left: one intersection with four arrows. North: row minus 1, while row > dest. South: row plus 1, while row < dest. East: col plus 1, while col < dest. West: col minus 1, while col > dest. Right: the trip from (1, 3) to (3, 0) on a 4 by 4 grid: the path goes down two rows, then left three columns. South runs twice, north is skipped, east is skipped, west runs three times. A loop whose condition starts False never runs, so no if/else is needed. The path is [(2,3), (3,3), (3,2), (3,1), (3,0)].
svg.text: A loop whose condition starts False
never runs, so no if/else is needed.
